# Kyverno
A Kubernetes-native policy management engine

#### About this dashboard

This dashboard represents generic insights which can be extracted and made well use of from a cluster with Kyverno in action.

#### For more details around the metrics

Checkout the [official docs of Kyverno metrics](https://kyverno.io/docs/monitoring-kyverno-with-prometheus-metrics/)

targets.expr: sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="kubelet", metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor", namespace="$kyvernoNS",container!="", image!="", cluster="$cluster"}) / sum(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{job="kube-state-metrics", namespace="$kyvernoNS", resource="memory", cluster="$cluster"})
sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="kubelet", metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor", namespace="$kyvernoNS", container!="", image!="", cluster="$cluster"}) by (pod)
